title: Project Cost Controller
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Job location is Almaty, Kazakhstan.

To coordinate with the Proposal & Estimation, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution departments to consolidate project-related commercial and financial information, establish project budgets, monitor actual expenditure, evaluate project profitability, and ensure a structured handover of projects to the execution team.

The role is responsible for developing a standardized project cost control and commercial reporting system to support management in effective project planning, cost monitoring, and profitability analysis.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Project Proposal & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Sales/Marketing and Proposal & Estimation teams to obtain project enquiries, quotations, technical and commercial proposals, and order-related information.
* Review approved proposals and consolidate the estimated project cost, selling price, expected revenue, and anticipated profit margin.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure that all commercial and cost-related inputs are available before project handover.
* Prepare a project commercial summary based on the approved proposal and purchase order/contract.

**B. Project Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Develop project budgets based on approved proposals, estimates, and contract values.
* Establish a baseline budget covering material, bought-out items, fabrication, machining, labour, subcontracting, inspection, testing, logistics, and other applicable project costs.
* Track budgeted cost versus actual cost and identify cost variances.
* Monitor project expenditure, commitments, and remaining budget throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare project-wise cost reports highlighting budget, actual expenditure, cost-to-complete, forecast final cost, and expected profitability.
* Identify potential cost overruns and communicate deviations to management for timely corrective action.

**C. Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate with Procurement to obtain material requisitions, purchase orders, supplier quotations, and procurement cost details.
* Consolidate material and bought-out item costs against the approved project budget.
* Track purchase commitments, material costs, delivery status, and potential cost variations.
* Coordinate with Accounts and Procurement to reconcile purchase orders, supplier invoices, and actual procurement expenditure.

**D. Accounts & Finance Coordination**

* Coordinate with Accounts & Finance to obtain project-wise actual expenditure, supplier invoices, subcontractor costs, labour costs, and other relevant financial information.
* Monitor project revenue, customer invoicing, receipts, outstanding payments, and project-related expenses in coordination with Accounts.
* Reconcile estimated costs with actual booked costs and identify discrepancies.
* Prepare project-wise financial summaries and profitability reports for management review.

**E. Project Handover & Documentation**

* Develop a standardized Project Commercial Handover Format for transferring projects from the Sales/Proposal stage to Project Execution.
* Ensure that all relevant commercial and cost information is consolidated before project handover.
* Coordinate with the Project Manager and execution team to explain the approved budget, cost assumptions, scope of work, commercial commitments, and cost-sensitive items.
* Maintain project-wise records of approved proposals, budgets, purchase orders, cost sheets, and commercial revisions.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of project cost information.

**F. Management Reporting & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare periodic project cost control reports for the Director and senior management.
* Monitor expected profit, actual profitability, gross margin, and forecast profit for each project.
* Compare the original budget with actual expenditure and forecast final cost.
* Highlight financial risks, unplanned expenditure, scope changes, and opportunities for cost savings.
* Develop and maintain Excel-based dashboards and standardized reporting formats for management decision-making.

3. Project Cost Control Parameters

The candidate should be capable of preparing and maintaining the following project-wise information:

**ParameterDescriptionContract ValueApproved project selling priceBudgeted CostEstimated total project costActual CostCost booked to dateCommitted CostApproved purchase orders and other commitments not yet fully bookedCost to CompleteForecast cost required to finish the projectForecast Final CostExpected total cost at completionExpected ProfitContract value less forecast final costProfit Margin (%)Expected profit as a percentage of contract valueCost VarianceDifference between budgeted and actual/forecast costRevenue & ReceivablesInvoicing, collections, and outstanding customer payments

*Note: The reporting format should clearly distinguish actual costs, committed costs, and forecast costs to avoid double counting.*

4. Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Additional qualifications or certifications in Finance, Cost Accounting, Project Management, or Commercial Management will be an advantage.
* Candidates with an engineering degree and strong practical experience in project costing, commercial coordination, and financial reporting are preferred.

5. Required Experience

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in project coordination, project cost control, commercial operations, or project financial reporting.
* Experience in the Oil & Gas, heat exchanger manufacturing, pressure vessel, heavy fabrication, or engineering project industry is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Proposal & Estimation, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution teams.
* Experience in project budgeting, cost tracking, variance analysis, and profitability reporting.

6. Technical Skills

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and reporting dashboards.
* Knowledge of project costing, budget monitoring, cost variance analysis, and profit margin calculations.
* Familiarity with ERP/accounting systems and project-wise cost tracking.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple departments into a single standardized reporting format.
* Good documentation, data analysis, and report preparation skills.

7. Key Competencies

* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Commercial and financial awareness.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in cost reporting.
* Ability to follow up with multiple departments and obtain timely inputs.
* Ability to present clear, concise reports to senior management.
* Proactive identification of cost overruns and profitability risks.

8. Expected Deliverables

The selected candidate will be expected to establish and maintain:

* Standard Project Commercial Summary Format.
* Project Budget and Cost Breakdown Sheet.
* Budget vs. Actual Cost Monitoring Report.
* Procurement Cost and Commitment Tracking Sheet.
* Project Profitability and Forecast Cost Report.
* Project Commercial Handover Checklist.
* Monthly Project Cost Control Dashboard for Management.

9. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely preparation of project budgets and commercial handover documents.
* Accuracy and completeness of project cost reports.
* Timely identification and reporting of cost variances.
* Timeliness of departmental input collection and cost reconciliation.
* Reliability of forecast final cost and project profitability reports.
* Implementation and consistent use of standardized project cost control formats.

10. Overall Role Objective

To establish a systematic project commercial and cost control process that connects Proposal & Estimation, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution, enabling management to monitor each project's approved budget, actual spending, commitments, forecast cost, revenue, and expected profitability from order receipt through project completion.

title: Interior Project Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Interior Project Manager will be responsible for the **end\-to\-end execution of assigned interior projects**, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed **scope, timeline, budget and quality standards**.

The role involves close coordination between the **Design Team, Project Engineering Team, Factory/Manufacturing Team, vendors, contractors, suppliers and clients**.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, technically strong, proactive in problem\-solving and comfortable taking ownership of multiple moving parts on an interior project.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take complete ownership of assigned interior projects from design handover to final completion.
* Review the approved design, drawings, BOQ, scope of work, specifications and project requirements before execution.
* Prepare and maintain project execution schedules and milestones.
* Break down projects into activity\-wise execution plans and monitor progress against timelines.
* Coordinate dependencies between civil, electrical, carpentry, modular furniture, painting, false ceiling, flooring, plumbing and other trades.
* Identify potential execution bottlenecks in advance and take corrective action.
* Ensure projects progress according to the approved sequence and schedule.

2\. Site Management

* Conduct regular site visits and monitor day\-to\-day execution.
* Coordinate with site labour/contractors.
* Ensure site activities are executed as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, installation and workmanship.
* Coordinate site readiness before commencement of each activity.
* Ensure proper protection of completed works and materials at site.
* Maintain site discipline, cleanliness and safe working practices.

3\. Design \& Technical Coordination

* Review drawings and designs before execution and identify technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the Design Team to resolve design clarifications and site constraints.
* Ensure that no deviation from approved drawings is executed without appropriate approval.
* Coordinate site measurements and verify critical dimensions before manufacturing or installation.
* Ensure coordination between 2D drawings, 3D designs, BOQ, cutlists and actual site conditions.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and communicate them proactively to the relevant team.

4\. Vendor \& Contractor Management

* Coordinate and manage contractors, installers, fabricators and specialised vendors.
* Allocate work and establish expected completion timelines.
* Monitor contractor performance, productivity and workmanship.
* Ensure vendors adhere to Antara Haus quality and execution standards.
* Coordinate material delivery, installation and rectification activities.
* Track pending works and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate persistent vendor performance or quality issues.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate sourcing of required materials to ensure availability as per project schedule.
* Prepare and communicate material requirements sufficiently in advance.
* Track material orders, expected delivery dates and site requirements.
* Verify received materials against specifications and quantities where required.
* Identify material shortages, damages or specification mismatches immediately.
* Coordinate urgent procurement requirements to prevent project delays.
* Ensure materials are properly stored and handled at site.

6\. Quality Control

* Maintain high standards of workmanship across all project activities.
* Conduct regular quality inspections at critical stages.
* Check dimensions, alignment, finish, detailing, installation and functionality.
* Ensure modular furniture and site works meet approved design specifications.
* Identify defects and coordinate rectification with the responsible contractor/vendor.
* Maintain snag lists and track closure of all observations.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections and ensure all punch\-list items are closed.

7\. Client Coordination

* Act as the primary project execution point of contact for the client where required.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming activities and site requirements clearly.
* Coordinate client approvals required for execution.
* Manage expectations regarding timelines, site conditions and execution requirements.
* Escalate design changes, scope changes and potential cost/time impacts to management before committing.
* Ensure client concerns are recorded, assigned and closed systematically.
* Maintain a professional and solution\-oriented relationship with clients.

8\. Project Cost \& Scope Control

* Ensure execution remains within the approved project scope and BOQ.
* Identify additional works, variations and scope changes before execution.
* Obtain appropriate approval for changes before committing resources or costs.
* Monitor material wastage and avoid unnecessary rework.
* Coordinate with the management/accounts team regarding project\-related commercial matters where required.
* Highlight potential cost overruns or commercial risks at an early stage.

9\. Project Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure all project tasks and follow\-ups are recorded in the company's task management system.
* Maintain project schedules, site reports, material requirements, snag lists and progress updates.
* Submit regular project status reports covering:
* Work completed
* Work in progress
* Planned activities
* Labour/contractor status
* Material availability
* Material requirements
* Delays and risks
* Client dependencies
* Quality issues
* Decisions/approvals required
* Ensure project information is current and accessible to the relevant internal teams.

10\. Project Handover

* Coordinate final project completion and snag closure.
* Conduct final quality checks before client handover.
* Ensure all installations, hardware, appliances, lighting and furniture are functional.
* Coordinate cleaning and final site preparation.
* Ensure project documentation and relevant warranties/manuals are collected where applicable.
* Obtain project completion and client handover confirmation.
* Coordinate post\-handover rectification during the applicable defect\-liability period.
